target_reference_entry: Chuyu Wang, Lei Xie, Yuancan Lin, Wei Wang, Yingying Chen, Yanling Bu, Kai Zhang, and Sanglu Lu. 2022. Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration. Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies 5, 4 (Dec. 2022), 182:1–182:25.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文（关于量子无线传感）在相关工作中简要提及RFID技术用于传感，但未具体描述或引用目标论文的RFID亚毫米级振动感知能力或穿墙窃听方法。实际上，目标论文与量子无线传感并无直接关联。

evidences.evidence_quote: A large variety of wireless technologies are utilized for sensing, including WiFi [4, 42, 61], bluetooth [40, 43], RFID [12,15,27], LoRa [13,14,54,58], UWB [16,59,60] and FMCW radar [6,7,26,55].
evidences.evidence_context: In Section 6 (Related Work), the citing paper lists various wireless technologies used for RF sensing, including RFID, but does not mention the target paper's specific method or findings.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用论文在相关工作中仅将RFID列为一种无线传感技术，并引用了其他RFID工作（[12,15,27]），但未引用目标论文[49]。目标论文未被提及，因此属于误判的引文匹配，建议排除。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 引用论文在相关工作中未提及目标论文，仅在列举RFID传感技术时引用了其他文献，目标论文未被引用。
